description:
Born from a course that redefines what racing means, the exceptionally exclusive BMW M 1000 RR Limited Edition Isle of Man TT pays homage to the most demanding road race on the planet.

Strictly limited to exactly 115 sequentially numbered units. British Racing Green uni matt meets matt carbon fibre, exclusive Isle of Man TT branding, and a tribute the legendary Mountain Course.
